notes: p-IgGen, an autoregressive paired-antibody language model, at Hugging Face revision 0e5c4ed4e4c6bed0a0c7e56ad6fa24c63ed56023 (ollieturnbull/p-IgGen). Per-file URLs are pinned in the untracked retrieval record data/raw/her2_functional_20260918/piggen/manifest.json; each is https://huggingface.co/ollieturnbull/p-IgGen/resolve/0e5c4ed4e4c6bed0a0c7e56ad6fa24c63ed56023/<file>, and model.safetensors additionally matches its upstream LFS sha256. ARCHITECTURE, verified by strict load: GPTNeoXForCausalLM, 4 layers, 8 heads, hidden 768, intermediate 2048, vocab 26, 22,097,408 parameters, hidden_dropout 0.0 and attention_dropout 0.0 (classifier_dropout 0.1 is inert for this head and must not be 'fixed'). TOKENIZER DEFECT, load-bearing: the tokenizer is a ByteLevel BPE with an EMPTY merge table, so it is character-level in fact and this repository maps characters to ids directly rather than going through the ByteLevel encoder. The real biological sentinels are '1' -> 23 and '2' -> 24 with <PAD> 0, but config.json ships bos_token_id 0 and eos_token_id 2 - and 2 is the residue R. Generation therefore never consults those ids: it runs exactly ten steps, and an internal arginine cannot terminate it. PRETRAINING EXPOSURE IS UNRESOLVED. The model card states pretraining on unpaired heavy and light OAS followed by paired finetuning. An earlier paired-corpus scan (reference/piggen-backbone-candidate.md) queried CR9114, not HER2. Neither paired nor unpaired corpus exposure has been scanned for HER2. The 3.276 GB unpaired-heavy archive remains unscanned, and archive-to-shipped-checkpoint lineage is unreconciled (54,110 pairs, 3.01%). No claim of clean exposure is made anywhere, conditional on nothing. The matched random-initialization arm is exposure-free by construction and is carried for that reason as well as for budget matching. RETRIEVAL DATE: the piggen retrieval record carries no date of its own; the date recorded here is the retrieval date of the HER2 data root it sits inside. The same revision was first audited on 2026-09-14 (reference/evidence/piggen-release-audit-2026-09-14.json).
